11. **FLOW-007-S11 — Evaluate deterministic policy.** Store all normalized concepts with rule-set version: case sensitivity, requested action, evidence quality, model class, financial-impact category, confidence bands. Policy returns `AUTO_ALLOW`, `HUMAN_REVIEW`, `REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE`, or `DENY`; LLM risk tags cannot override it.
The Policy Evaluator is deterministic, not an LLM agent. An LLM may propose risk tags but cannot override outcomes. High-impact recommendations become review tasks rather than autonomous mutations.

source_evidence.quote_en: At the interface boundary, ApprovalTask records shall carry tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and a correlation ID wherever the operation changes durable state. The request path GET /v1/review-queue must validate input before allocating a long-running operation; if a dependency is unavailable, callers receive a documented retryable error or a persisted asynchronous job identifier, never an ambiguous success.

The request path GET /v1/cases/{caseId}/evidence must validate input before allocating a long-running operation; if a dependency is unavailable, callers receive a documented retryable error or a persisted asynchronous job identifier, never an ambiguous success.

At the interface boundary, ReviewForm records shall carry tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and a correlation ID wherever the operation changes durable state.
